text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Parliament Street, City Council approval of this report is required. At its meeting on January 26, 2023, Toronto and East York Community Council requested Transportation Services to investigate the feasibility of providing free parking at several locations on Parliament Street for mosques. This report provides information that these requests are not supported at this time, but will be considered as part of a broader City-wide Parking Strategy study being undertaken by Transportation Services this year, with a final report coming to City Council in Q2 of 2024.

City Council on May 10, 11 and 12, 2023, adopted the following: 1. City Council rescind the existing parking machine regulation in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday and from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Saturday, for a maximum period of three hours and at a rate of $2.00 per hour, on the east side of Parliament Street, between Queen Street East and Gerrard Street East. 2. City Council authorize the installation of parking machines on the east side of Parliament Street, between Queen Street East and Shuter Street, to be in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday and from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Saturday, for a maximum period of three hours and at a rate of $2.00 per hour. 3.
